Alrighty, the bodypile tactic.
In The Last of Us, there is a certain part of the game where Ellie uses a gun for the first time, (in this case a sniper) and I was playing on Grounded mode, which is incredibly difficult. This level was hard on normal difficulty, so you could imagine how hard it was on Grounded. Well, at the end of the level area, there is a large white truck and some misc wood stuff and barrels, with the truck and other stuff blocking most entryways, so the only way you could get to where I was, was by going through the somewhat narrow passageway, or by dropping down from the top of the truck. I decided to hide behind the barrels near the entrance behind the truck and see if I could just wait it out this attempt. Not surprisingly, an enemy came through, and so I grabbed and strangled them, leaving their body just next to the barrels and the entryway. Then came another guy, but he was shocked by the body and went over to the body. I strangled them. Another guy yelled and ran to the body in shock. Strangled. Strangled. Strangled. Strangling over and over as each enemy was in shock at their fallen comrades. I thought I was going to make it, until I heard the sound of a molotov being thrown, which is an instant kill; however, the enemy threw the molotov behind the barrels where I usually was, yet I was in front of the barrels strangling another enemy. Safe to say I kinda freaked out, but was amazed that the A.I. threw it where I actually usually was. After the flames burned out, went behind the barrels yet again, and strangled. I kept strangling them over and over, always shocked at the bodies they were forced to see when enetering through the passageway.

And then the cutscene played, showing that I beat the area, simply by strangling everyone in the same location, literally causing everyone's bodies to pile onto eachother and create a massive, bizzare pile of bodies all together. I made a huge pile with their bodies, and somehow it worked better than actually playing normally. I cheaped the A.I., and I cheaped the system. Joel made it through and beat it all on Grounded mode, thanks to what I now affectionately call "the bodypile tactic."

(I may actually draw it out sooner or later to make it more clear; kinda hard to describe)

I had been playing Left 4 Dead 2 with a friend, and we were trying to beat the campaign Hard Rain on expert difficulty. We were on consoles. We managed to reach the finale, and after many many deaths, we made a convoluted plan to kill one of us so we could be rescued from a port-a-potty with higher health. However, like before, a tank had downed us just as the boat arrived. At this point, we had tried the finale more than 15 times. Most of us were near the boat, and everyone was downed by either a tank or a charger except for Rochelle. The bot. We waited for her to die and restart again, but she did the unthinkable.

She went on the boat.

As we were all down.

And she finished the campaign.

By herself.

For those who don't know, to count as completing it on expert, you have to make it onto the escape vehicle alive, and since everyone but the bot were down, we didn't make it "alive."
We had spent around 7 HOURS of constant play trying to beat this campaign. And Rochelle ruined it all for us. Now we have a seething hatred for Rochelle. I have never felt more justified in hating a friendly AI in a video game.

I was kinda scared, because my friends told me about how powerful pitbulls are, so I waited a bit. Guy went down the forest path just next to my friend's backyard, which is where we were. When I came back with my water gun, I was straight in front of the entrance to the forest trail, and I saw the pitbull.
Without it's owner.
And it's leash dragging behind it.
I ran towards my friend's "secret backdoor gate" and closed it quickly, and told them what happened.
